_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Forty-third scheduled run. 16 of 22 URLs served and 10,370 product pages reviewed, a new high. NO NEW MATCHES against the chart anywhere.

ERGONZI FAILED ON A CONNECTION RESET FOR THE SECOND CONSECUTIVE RUN, after 2026-11-09. On both occasions a direct check minutes later found the site serving normally and the --only re-pull returned its full 520 products with all 33 cases present. Reported as checked because it served. Two in a row is a pattern worth watching rather than ignoring, but nothing yet distinguishes it from ordinary network noise: the site has never refused the retry, the failure is a TCP reset rather than a status code, and no other site on the roster shows it.

Eight listings stand removed, each confirmed by HTTP 404: MYROSEWORL-001..003, KATEROSES-001, HILLSIDERO-004, -005 and -007, SPRINGLAND-004. HILLSIDERO-005 is absent a second run after its eighth disappearance, and HILLSIDERO-007 a second run since it went on 2026-11-10. 450 of 463 cases verified present.

The five Commerce Farms cases were left untouched again: nothing here can re-verify an Etsy listing.

SCREENSHOTS 413 OF 463, unchanged in count today but transformed yesterday: the user photographed all eight of High Garden's Registered listings by hand on 2026-11-10, closing that gap entirely and taking Registered coverage from 53 to 61 of 62. All five of High Garden's "Inspired by" disclaimer listings now carry an image. The one Registered gap left is ONELOVEROS-002, behind a membership wall that is recorded and not bypassed. Of the 50 open gaps, 44 are High Garden's and capturable: 17 Pending, 11 To Be Filed, 6 Not Applicable, 6 unstatused and 4 Abandoned.

Mola Rose and Muse Roses reported identical catalog sizes and identical match counts for the twelfth consecutive run (789 / 48 each). Still flagged with the user, still not acted on.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.

Etsy storefront, added to the roster 2026-11-03. Etsy publishes no open product feed and etsy.com is unreachable from this environment (HTTP 403 at the proxy's CONNECT stage), so this seller cannot be crawled and is a standing coverage gap. Its five cases, COMMERCEFA-001..005, were built on 2026-11-03 from listing URLs and screenshots the user gathered by hand; they are not re-verified by this run and their Last Verified dates deliberately did not move.

The scheduled 06:04 pull failed on a connection reset by peer -- the SECOND consecutive run on which this site has done that, after 2026-11-09. Both times a direct check minutes later found it serving normally (HTTP 200 on its home page and its Shopify feed) and both times the re-pull returned the full 520 products with every one of its 33 cases present. Reported as checked because it served. Worth watching: two in a row is a pattern rather than a one-off, though nothing yet distinguishes it from ordinary network noise, and the site has never once refused the retry.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.
Served at 216 products, unchanged. MYROSEWORL-001..003 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Served at 174 products, unchanged. HILLSIDERO-005 still present; -004 still removed (HTTP 404).
Shopify storefront; the store's own product feed answered normally and returned zero products. The catalog is empty, not unreachable -- the site was checked in full.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.
Served at 62 products, unchanged. KATEROSES-001 and -002 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Served at 1,943 products, up 56 from 2026-10-26 and 88 over three runs. None of the additions matched a chart name.

screenshot_limitation: 413 of 463 cases carry a screenshot. The 50 without one each record why: High Garden 44 -- the seller's pages blank themselves on detecting an automated browser, so these need manual capture and the measure was not bypassed; One Love 3 (1 Registered) -- a membership login wall, also not bypassed; Flower Meadow Dream 3 -- listings removed, HTTP 404. High Garden's REGISTERED gap was closed entirely on 2026-11-10 when the user photographed all eight by hand; the 44 that remain are 17 Pending and 27 carrying no enforceable right.
